brief: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors.

requirements.requirement: Two separate pairs of bases (four bases total arranged as two pairs)
requirements.evidence: 4× piece:full at (0,0), (0,1), (1,0), (1,1) — visually two pairs: left pair (0,0)+(0,1) and right pair (1,0)+(1,1)

requirements.requirement: The pairs joined to each other only with side connectors (no other inter-pair linkage)
requirements.evidence: 3× side-connector-double: connector:0#0,0|0,1 (joins left pair), connector:0#1,0|1,1 (joins right pair), connector:0#0|1,0 (bridges the two pairs). Pairs touch by connector only; no fused bases or other connector types between pairs.

finish.summary: Built 2×2 block of 4 bases as two pairs, with each pair internally linked by a side-connector-double and the pairs bridged by a third side-connector-double. Caps applied and joints locked; meshClash clear.

lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

result.note: No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
